=== file pty-t1.sh ===
#!/bin/sh
M="$HOME/.koloft/m-0000000000000000"
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.koloft/node/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
if [ -z "$LC_ALL$LC_CTYPE" ]; then
  case "$(locale charmap 2>/dev/null)" in
  ANSI_X3.4-1968|US-ASCII)
    koloft_u=$(locale -a 2>/dev/null | awk '{ l = tolower($0) }
      l ~ /^c\.utf-?8$/ && c == "" { c = $0 }
      l ~ /^en_us\.utf-?8$/ && e == "" { e = $0 }
      l ~ /\.utf-?8$/ && u == "" { u = $0 }
      END { print (c != "" ? c : (e != "" ? e : u)) }')
    if [ -n "$koloft_u" ]; then
      case "${LANG:-C}" in
      C|POSIX) LC_CTYPE=$koloft_u; export LC_CTYPE ;;
      *) LANG=$koloft_u; export LANG ;;
      esac
    fi
    unset koloft_u ;;
  esac
fi
koloft_git="'include.path=$HOME/.koloft/git-accounts/config'"; case "$GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS" in *"$koloft_git"*) ;; *) GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS="${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:+$GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS }$koloft_git"; export GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS ;; esac; unset koloft_git
[ -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass" ] && { set -a; . "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass"; set +a; rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/tabs/pty-t1.pass"; }
sh "$M/ensure-codex.sh" '999.0.0' || exit $?
PATH="$HOME/.koloft/codex-cli/bin:$PATH"; export PATH
H="$HOME/.koloft/codex-home"
mkdir -p "$H" "$HOME/.koloft/cx/table-instance" && chmod 700 "$H" "$HOME/.koloft/cx/table-instance" || exit 3
mkdir -p "$H/skills"; { diff -r "$M/docs-plugin/skills/koloft-docs" "$H/skills/koloft-docs" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -rf "$H/skills/koloft-docs.new-$$" && cp -R "$M/docs-plugin/skills/koloft-docs" "$H/skills/koloft-docs.new-$$" && rm -rf "$H/skills/koloft-docs" && mv "$H/skills/koloft-docs.new-$$" "$H/skills/koloft-docs"; }; }; { diff -r "$M/agent-plugin/skills/koloft" "$H/skills/koloft" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -rf "$H/skills/koloft.new-$$" && cp -R "$M/agent-plugin/skills/koloft" "$H/skills/koloft.new-$$" && rm -rf "$H/skills/koloft" && mv "$H/skills/koloft.new-$$" "$H/skills/koloft"; }; }
cd '/home/me/proj' || exit 3
S="$HOME/.koloft/cx/table-instance/pty-t1"
rm -f "$S".* "$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions/pty-t1.shell-wrote.jsonl"
PATH="$PATH":'/opt/login-shell/bin:/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin'
(
  KOLOFT_TAB_ID='pty-t1'; export KOLOFT_TAB_ID
  CODEX_HOME="$H"; PATH="$M/bin:$PATH"; export CODEX_HOME PATH
  KOLOFT_CODEX_REPLY_LANGUAGE="$M/codex-reply-language.sh"; KOLOFT_CODEX_SAID="$S.said"; KOLOFT_NOTICE="$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions/pty-t1.notice"
  KOLOFT_SHELL_WROTE="$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions/pty-t1.shell-wrote.jsonl"; KOLOFT_CODEX_DISCORD_SAID="$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions/pty-t1.discord-said"
  export KOLOFT_CODEX_REPLY_LANGUAGE KOLOFT_CODEX_SAID KOLOFT_NOTICE KOLOFT_SHELL_WROTE KOLOFT_CODEX_DISCORD_SAID
  KOLOFT_HOLD_TAB=pty-t1; export KOLOFT_HOLD_TAB
  command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec setsid nohup codex app-server --listen "unix://$S.sock" -c 'tui.status_line=["context-used","five-hour-limit","weekly-limit","git-branch","codex-version","model-with-reasoning","estimated-thread-cost","pull-request-number","current-dir"]' -c 'sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true' -c 'developer_instructions="<Koloft'\''s \"prompt\" for codex>"' -c 'features.default_mode_request_user_input=true' -c 'allow_login_shell=false' -c 'cli_auth_credentials_store="ephemeral"' -c "sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots=[\"$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions\"]"
  exec nohup codex app-server --listen "unix://$S.sock" -c 'tui.status_line=["context-used","five-hour-limit","weekly-limit","git-branch","codex-version","model-with-reasoning","estimated-thread-cost","pull-request-number","current-dir"]' -c 'sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true' -c 'developer_instructions="<Koloft'\''s \"prompt\" for codex>"' -c 'features.default_mode_request_user_input=true' -c 'allow_login_shell=false' -c 'cli_auth_credentials_store="ephemeral"' -c "sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots=[\"$HOME/.koloft/hook-sessions\"]"
) </dev/null >"$S.log" 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$S.pid"
i=0
while [ ! -e "$S.sock" ]; do
  i=$((i + 1))
  if [ "$i" -gt 150 ] || ! kill -0 "$(cat "$S.pid")" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo '[Koloft] Codex did not start on this machine:'; tail -n 20 "$S.log"; exit 5
  fi
  sleep 0.1
done
exit 0

koloft_git="'include.path=$HOME/.koloft/git-accounts/config'"; case "$GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS" in *"$koloft_git"*) ;; *) GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS="${GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS:+$GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS }$koloft_git"; export GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS ;; esac; unset koloft_git
D="$HOME/.koloft/cx/table-instance"
tree_of() {
  ps -eo pid=,ppid= | awk -v r="$1" '{ p[$1] = $2 } END { s[r] = 1; do { c = 0; for (x in p) if (!(x in s) && (p[x] in s)) { s[x] = 1; c = 1 } } while (c); for (x in s) print x }'
}
any_alive() {
  for x in $all; do
    case "$(ps -o stat= -p "$x" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')" in ''|Z*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
  done
  return 1
}
signal_and_wait() {
  kill -s "$1" $all 2>/dev/null
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt "$2" ] && any_alive; do sleep 0.2; n=$((n+1)); done
}
stop_one() {
  p="$D/$1.pid"
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    pid=$(cat "$p")
    case "$(ps -p "$pid" -o args= 2>/dev/null)" in
      *app-server*)
        all=$(tree_of "$pid")
        signal_and_wait TERM 6
        signal_and_wait KILL 10 ;;
    esac
  fi
  rm -f "$D/$1".*
}
for p in "$D"/*.pid; do [ -f "$p" ] && stop_one "$(basename "$p" .pid)"; done
rm -f "$HOME/.koloft/codex-home/auth.json"
exit 0
